ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity (white) central lobe surfaces against 35% low-intensity (black) peripheral and hinge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central-to-distal regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges. Fine-scale dark mottling is present at the transition zones, particularly on the inner medial sections of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees at the point of lobe convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the distal third of each lobe, tapering in frequency toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the posterior margins curving upward toward distal tips; the leading edge presents a more linear-to-slightly-convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast tan and brown textured clusters (protrusions) located at the extreme distal tips (vertices) of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical low-intensity linear streaks visible on the high-intensity white field of the right lobe; left lobe shows minor horizontal disruptions near the leading edge margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes, creating a non-planar edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark circular pixel cluster (mottling) isolated within the high-intensity white field of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the hinge and the distal tip.
